entry.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT
entry.summary:
CODESEPARATOR in Bitcoin Script can be utilized to construct specific types of smart contracts, even prior to the introduction of Schnorr signatures. One notable application involves creating Scriptless Scripts by leveraging multiple signatures that each reference different placements of CODESEPARATOR within the script. By carefully arranging these separators, it is possible to design scenarios where the act of spending funds requires generating several signatures, all of which must reuse the same 'R' value. The deliberate reuse of this nonce results in the eventual exposure of the corresponding private key during the signing process.
A referenced example demonstrates all CODESEPARATOR operations placed within a single conditional branch of the script, which serves as an illustrative case for this advanced scripting technique. However, comprehending the full mechanics and implications of such scripts can be challenging and often necessitates a thorough review of discussions and examples from the Bitcoin development community, particularly those archived on the Lightning-dev mailing list.
For further exploration and technical details, consulting earlier discussions or source material related to the innovative use of CODESEPARATOR and Scriptless Scripts is advised.
